items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Buzzy got told to Harry, and they made Buzzy the leader, see? Well, he was in the band, but they made Buzzy the band leader... So when Bill was there, I got forty dollars a week... And then when Buzzy got told... I said, nah. I went to Harry, man

ctx.x: I didn't get into the job. I said, Goppsen, oh, he's a great drummer. Which he is. But the guy said, he got a break with B-Funk. I mean, the guy's a top-knop musician, man. He can play with anybody. How much did they pay at the fern? I'm always wondering. Well, I'll tell you that story, too. I'll give it to you straight. A nickel? A nickel? No, man. They didn't Father Goppsen, because poor man's dead, man. This Father Billy Gillen. He played just like Bakesh Pounder back then. He played trumpet. He was in the…
